description: State Representative Amy Elik was re-elected by the voters of the 111th district with 61.5% of the vote."I am incredibly honored and grateful to the people of the 111th district for placing their trust in me once again," said Elik. "To every supporter, volunteer, friend, and family member who stood by us—thank you.
